provenance.legend: Rows (instructions.<key>.mod_groups.<group>) may carry `_src`: a tag naming the measurement that produced or last repaired the row; `sources` below lists every tag in this table with its kind, date and, where it exists, the cubit tool and test that hold the evidence. `_note` on a row is the measurement in prose (bit positions, nvdisasm behaviour, what stays outside the row). Rows without `_src` are the 2026-06..08 harvest: fields learned from compiler output and validated by the round-trip census, not by per-field probes; their audit state is tracked in cubit's docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md (tools/audit_table.py, tools/audit_dynamic.py). `history` keeps the fix-wave notes that used to be loose `_meta.bugNNN` keys, verbatim; `errata` keeps the former top-level `_errata_*` notes (sm121a). Provenance is written once per level since 2026-11-08 (NEEDS 61): `instructions.<key>._src` is set when every row of the key carries the same tag (a row keeps its own `_src`; a row without one inherits the key's); the measurement note of a lattice family lives in `sources[<tag>].note` when every row of the tag shares it, on `instructions.<key>._note` when every row of the key shares it, and on the row only where the row's differs -- read a row's note as row `_note`, else key `_note`, else `sources[row's tag].note` (cubit `tools/tablefmt.py`: `row_src` / `row_note`). A field carries its own `_src` only when it was measured by another tag than its row. The file layout is tools/tablefmt.py's: compact JSON, one encoding row per line, indent=1 `_meta`.

history.wave11-lane-merge-2026-11-04: wave 11 (lane merge, candidate 2026-11-04): row-level 3-way merge of the fleet lane canon 952d336..2ccb266 (30 TABLE-ONLY commits: BUG-477..523, 458b-D2b/D2c, 458d1/d2, RR-B, 504-L1-expand-v3, 505a/b; lane-isa/lineage-2026-10-14) onto public fd3c7b1. Lane-origin rows normalized to the public hygiene (and_base bits [127:105] cleared). Where both sides changed the same row/field the PUBLIC value was first kept, then the sm120 cases were ARBITRATED with nvdisasm 13.3 bit probes (rows tagged _src_wave11_arb = wave11-arb-sm120-2026-11-04; evidence pubwave/wave11/arb_sm120.json): lane kept for ENDCOLLECTIVE[_P], ATOMG S32 claim_forbid, F2FP_R_R_R MERGE_C/PACK_AB.RZ; public kept for UIADD3.64, FADD_R_R_UR, FCHK, deleted HMMA phantoms; synthesis (public fields + lane payload-inert variable_mask + lane claim_forbid) for the F2FP family; WARPSYNC.COLLECTIVE_R_II = lane row + public guard field. One documented fixup on sm100a/sm103a: FMNMX3 plain f32-immediate row re-keyed II -> FI (tag wave11-fmnmx3-fi-2026-11-04).

alu_iadd3.description: 3-source ALU (IADD3, IMAD, FFMA) — Rc2 in hi[7:0]

alu_simple.description: 2-source ALU (MOV, SEL, IADD, FADD, FMUL, conversions, comparisons)

barrier.description: Barrier / sync / membar — no scheduling bits

ctrl_flow.description: Control flow (BRA, CALL, RET, BSSY, BSYNC, etc.) — no standard scheduling

exit_static.description: EXIT — fully static ctrl word, bit43 required

ldc.description: 32-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

ldc64.description: 64-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0xa is type discriminator

ldcu64.description: 64-bit uniform constant bank load — bit43=1 required

ldg.description: Global memory load (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed discriminators

lds.description: Shared memory load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

nop.description: NOP — fully static, no write/wait mask allowed

s2r.description: System register read — hi[15:8] = SR code (opcode extension, not scheduling)

stg.description: Global memory store (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed, upper 32 has write/wait

sts.description: Shared memory store — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator
